verdict.rationale: Threads clearly exist in Slack. First-party AI docs mention summarizing 'channels and threads', and community users describe threads as a section off to the side of the channel where replies live. That is real but indirect evidence of replying in threads attached to a parent message, and community users report usability limits such as thread replies surfacing only in a non-auto-updating view and no files or snippets in threads. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the thread-reply feature itself, any admin-specific thread controls, and independent evidence that the reported thread limitations are resolved.
